purpose: Compare two vehicle telemetry histories using lagged cross-correlation and a normalized overlay.
primaryGoal: Select two signals, optionally difference them, and inspect correlation strength, significance, sample evidence and which signal leads.

dataSources.ownership: Telemetry hook/catalog adapter; backend signalinspect handler
dataSources.behavior: AbortSignal forwarded; catalog reduced to signal names; page retains successful catalog on refresh failure. Rich kind/unit metadata is not available through this adapter.

Enabled only for positive vehicle ID and nonempty signal; AbortSignal forwarded; existing standard polling retained. Query key includes vehicle, signal and hours. Server returns typed raw measurements, expected_kind, from, to and count. Without limit, earliest 1000 rows in the requested interval are returned; hard cap is 10000.

dataSources.endpoint: Indirect useVehicles dependency; endpoint implementation not inspected
dataSources.behavior: URL/store/fleet fallback selection. Page has no competing vehicle picker. A null selection renders existing NoVehicleSelected.

dataSources.endpoint: Indirect settings dependencies; no additional telemetry endpoint
dataSources.ownership: Existing stats/preferences bridge and URL legend-state owner
dataSources.behavior: Numeric correlation/duration/sample inputs remain numeric; display preferences applied by shared formatter. Hidden a/b series persist under hidden_signal-correlation-overlay.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Same two-history fatal-error retry branch also appears at lines 331 and 393.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use a page-local retryBothFailed callback, retaining independent source retry buttons in the summary.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Two local interpretation boxes repeat surface/border/padding markup. This is not evidence for a new shared composite.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing surface primitives when adopting layout; keep both interpretation bodies and all badges/context.

responsive.sourceEvidence: Page:190 uses single-column controls below sm, two at sm, three at lg; page:406 interpretation grid reflows to two columns at sm. Shared PageLayout supplies full-width min-w-0. Charts use ResponsiveContainer with fixed 340/300 heights.

findings.detail: Default switch button is 44x24px; the clickable wrapper is not itself keyboard focusable. Select defaults to min-h-10 (40px) at Select.tsx:34. These are below the stronger 44px design-contract target; this is not a measured WCAG target-spacing failure.
findings.fix: Shared controls owner should provide/verify a 44px minimum hit area without enlarging the visual track, and retain focus, label activation, density settings and disabled behavior.

responsive.verification: All specified viewport/container widths, long signal names, 200% text and RTL unverified; no browser opened.

accessibility.sourceEvidence: Decorative title icons have aria-hidden; signal selects use labels; switch is named and exposes aria-checked; both charts provide localized ariaLabel and data/dataColumns; significance and lead include text, not color alone.

findings.detail: Detrending explanatory Text at lines 211-217 is not associated with the switch via aria-describedby, although Toggle supports forwarding that attribute to its button.
findings.fix: Give the hint a stable page-local ID and pass aria-describedby to Toggle; preserve label, explanation and checked semantics.

accessibility.verification: Keyboard, actual focus visibility, screen reader, effective contrast, forced-colors and reduced-motion behavior unverified.

preserved: Catalog initial error/loading/empty: QueryError with retry, Skeleton, telemetry-specific EmptyState.
Unchosen histories omitted from source notice using enabled flags.
Both histories required for joint result; initial fatal errors may replace joint charts/reading only.
Retained histories remain in calculation during refresh/error; summary exposes independent A/B retries and retained label.
Charts have loading/error/retry/empty contracts; reading and selection panels remain available.
Page-level DataSourceNotice already handles partial/refresh-failed/paused source evidence; do not introduce duplicate generic banners.

findings.detail: Every null correlation result after choosing signals is described as no overlapping history. crossCorrelate also returns null for fewer than two valid measurements, nonnumeric histories, too short a grid or no lag satisfying minimum 10 samples (signalCorrelation.ts:236-258). Reading empty text at page:400 asks to pick two even when both are selected.
findings.fix: Expose a feature-owned diagnostic reason alongside the unchanged calculation; distinguish choose-signals, empty history, unsupported measurement kinds and insufficient overlap/sample evidence. Do not fabricate zero or imply backend failure from an empty response.

states.limits: Offline branches source-inspected through dataState/source notice only. No failed/paused/retained/empty case exercised. Handler returns successful empty data if DB pool is absent (handler.go:272-282); page cannot distinguish that condition from genuinely empty history.

visualIssues.detail: Axis ticks set page-local fontSize 10/11 at lines 279-280,349-350 rather than shared chart typography. Saved font scale behavior and mobile readability are unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Adopt the existing chart typography/token owner, retaining axes, domains, units, sample tables and all reference lines. Subdue reference decoration without changing explicit saved chart palette choices.

visualIssues.detail: Both title icons use fixed cyan-300 at lines 166 and 386 despite carrying no distinct semantic status. Other inspected local surfaces already use neutral CSS variables; no glow/neon/body-white violation found by bounded pattern scan.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing muted/secondary icon token for structural headings. Do not create a palette or reset theme/chart preferences.

architectureIssues.detail: Hardcoded 24-hour history requests at lines 42-43; no useRangeState. /signal-correlation is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS (workspaceScope.ts:23-77), so global range control is not available for this historical analysis page.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should register this exact route only together with page useRangeState and a typed history hook accepting both startInstant/endInstantExclusive. Preserve last-24-hour default and current vehicle selection; do not add a local picker. Verify backend inclusive BETWEEN versus exclusive end semantics rather than assuming equality.

architectureIssues.detail: History hook omits limit. Server default is 1000 (handler.go:110), querying ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT (handler.go:309-319). High-rate signals may represent only the earliest part of the claimed 24-hour interval, with different actual coverage for A and B. Summary correctly says requested/overlapping samples, but gives no row-cap evidence.
architectureIssues.fix: Explicitly expose requested versus observed bounds/count and possible cap reach per source. Coordinate an analysis-history contract with the existing hook owner; increasing to 10000 is still capped and is not proof of full-range coverage. Preserve raw SI and existing query policy; do not fabricate truncation flags or invent aggregation endpoints.

architectureIssues.detail: Overlay stores only browser-local HH:mm strings; it bypasses saved locale/timezone and drops date/instant identity. Cross-midnight/DST repeated times become indistinguishable in tooltip and fallback table.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain epoch instants in chart rows and use existing useDateFormat for ticks and full date/time table/tooltip labels. Keep 0-1 normalization, null gaps and source ordering unchanged.

architectureIssues.detail: zeroLagR defaults to 0 when the zero-lag point was excluded for insufficient samples, while a nonzero lag may still produce a valid result. The summary prints that fallback as a measured zero at CorrelationStatStrip.tsx:27-28.
architectureIssues.fix: Feature owner must distinguish unavailable zero-lag coefficient from measured zero and show the existing unknown presentation. Treat this as a separately tested correctness change, not an aesthetic rewrite; preserve all other correlation math.

order: Explicit unknown zero-lag and truthful null-result reasons
Workspace bound integration and row-cap trust evidence

requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Extend/reuse typed history query with explicit from/to and limit, query key reflecting bounds, forwarded AbortSignal, current enablement/polling/retry behavior and unchanged raw payload. Consumer distinguishes requested bounds from first/last observed samples and cap-reached uncertainty; retain fatal/refresh/paused/empty states.
requiredSharedChanges.note: No new generic composite justified; coordinate existing hook/workspace owners, not page-owned shared edits.

requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Preserve sm/md visual track, checked/onChange/disabled and forwarded ARIA; provide at least 44px reachable hit box without competing event/focus wrapper. Select may already satisfy page needs using existing lg sizing, subject to density policy.
dependsOn: Keyboard/focus and touch-spacing tests at narrow widths
requiredSharedChanges.note: Source target-size gap, not an exercised accessibility failure; no new control API should be invented solely for this page.

Fixed page window bypasses workspace analysis window.
No competing chart library, table renderer, query store, stats formatter or overlay system found in inspected page/component source. Cross-feature duplication was not surveyed.

sections.name: Correlation metrics
metrics: Effective samples plus raw sample count

actions: Select signal A and signal B independently; clear via placeholder
Retry catalog and independent A/B history sources
Toggle overlay a/b legend visibility with existing URL persistence
Existing ChartContainer default image-export controls when content exists; CSV not configured
Existing shell vehicle selection; NoVehicleSelected branch
data: Typed numeric and boolean measurements; invalid timestamps/nonfinite values/enums/text discarded; ascending order and last-valid duplicate timestamp retained.
Raw SI remains unchanged in wire/cache/hooks; correlation and normalized overlay are dimensionless; signed lag is seconds.
Current algorithm: 60-second grid, 600-second last-known-value staleness, +/-1800-second lag sweep, minimum 10 paired samples.
Optional first differencing changes correlation calculation only; normalized overlay remains original resampled levels.
Absolute-peak lag selection with shortest-delay tie break; autocorrelation-adjusted effective sample size and existing significance/lead classification.
Preserve every correlogram point, n, +/-threshold lines, zero line, best-lag line and [-1,1] axis.
Preserve both normalized overlay series, [0,1] axis, constant-series midpoint 0.5 and genuine null gaps with connectNulls=false.
Preserve four summary measurements, descriptions/context, interpretation badges, filled/gap evidence and causation warning.
Preserve query ownership, enablement, cancellation, polling and retained-data behavior. Proposed correctness fixes require focused tests; no math altered during audit.
